name: nimbrio-ai
description: A prompt-driven agent built from scratch on any OpenAI-compatible API

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @app/shared && npm run build -w @app/agent && npm run build -w @app/db
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @app/api && npm run build -w @app/cli && npm run build -w @app/web
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @app/api
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w @app/api" "npm run dev -w @app/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @app/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @app/shared && npm run dev -w @app/web
scripts.cli: npm run build:packages && npm run start -w @app/cli --
scripts.ask: npm run build:packages && npm run start -w @app/cli -- --once
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.eval: npm run build -w @app/shared && npm run eval -w @app/agent
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
